item.title: Doepfer Chaotic Patch A-112 Sampler / Wavetable Module!
item.description: video upload by Doepfer Musikelektronik GmbH "Chaotic patch with the A-112 sampler!🪩🤸‍♀️ In this patch the A-112 is used as a lofi effect in the feedback loop of the A-119 Spring Reverb. All sounds are out of the system! The bassline is a combination of the A-110-2 Basic VCO and the A-124 Wasp Filter. The A-188-1 BBD is used as a Karplus-Strong synthesizer. https://doepfer.de/a112.htm https:/
